title_en: Garment Academy | Knitting and Nonwoven Technology

A little of everything, chosen to be useful.
translations.Thông số kỹ thuật cần đối chiếu với tech: Technical requirements must be checked against the approved tech pack, standards and product-specific requirements.
translations.Nguyên tắc kỹ thuật: không có một công t: Technical principle: there is no single temperature, pH, time or chemical recipe that applies to every fabric style. The process depends on fibre type, dyes, equipment, shade depth, liquor ratio, machine load, auxiliaries and customer requirements. Figures in reference materials are examples for a particular process system; use a recipe confirmed through lab dips, a pilot trial and the chemical supplier.
translations.Cách học và áp dụng. Với mỗi cấu trúc, h: How to study and apply this material: for each construction, identify the yarn/loop direction, surface, bonding method and relevant inspection parameters. For each style, record the test standard, specimen-conditioning conditions, sampling location, unit and applicable specification revision so that results can be compared.
translations.Đọc thông số trước khi đọc tên thương mạ: Read the specification before relying on the commercial name. “Cotton”, “polyester” or “viscose” identifies only part of the raw material. Confirm the percentage composition, staple/filament form, fineness, fibre length, yarn structure, count, twist, evenness and end-use requirements. Test values are meaningful only when accompanied by units, methods and test conditions.
translations.Vải dệt kim được hình thành bằng cách uố: Knitted fabric is formed by bending yarn into interconnected loops. Loop geometry gives the fabric its characteristic deformation behaviour, while stretch and recovery also depend on the yarn, construction, density and finishing.
translations.Đọc hình theo hướng course và wale; đối: Read the diagram in the course and wale directions. Confirm the face and reverse sides against an actual sample of each construction.
translations.01 · Vòng sợi là đơn vị cấu trúc: 01 · The Loop as the Basic Structural Unit
translations.Vải knit hình thành khi sợi được uốn thà: Knitted fabric is formed when yarn is bent into loops that intermesh with adjacent loops. A loop consists of a head, two legs and connecting segments. Under load, loops can change shape and redistribute the force, producing structural extensibility. This differs from the elastic stretch provided by elastane: a fabric may extend through loop geometry without fully recovering to its original dimensions.
translations.Khi soi mẫu, quan sát độ dài chân vòng,: When examining a sample, observe loop-leg length, inclination and consistency between wales. A dropped loop can develop into a ladder or run along the wale direction. Record the defect direction and inspect adjacent areas rather than measuring the hole alone.
translations.02 · Course, wale, CPI, WPI và loop leng: 02 · Course, Wale, CPI, WPI and Loop Length
translations.Course là hàng vòng, wale là cột vòng. C: A course is a horizontal row of loops; a wale is a vertical column of loops. CPI and WPI are the numbers of courses and wales per inch, respectively. Loop length is the amount of yarn used to form a loop. Changes in loop length affect density, GSM, thickness, dimensions and fabric hand. These relationships should not be treated as isolated formulas because yarn tension, yarn properties and finishing also influence the result.
translations.Khi so sánh hai lot, đo CPI và WPI tại n: When comparing two lots, measure CPI and WPI at multiple locations according to the sampling plan, then compare the results with GSM and relaxed width. If CPI increases without a corresponding increase in GSM, review loop length, yarn count, finishing and sampling-location differences before drawing a conclusion.
translations.Weft knitting cấp sợi theo hướng ngang,: Weft knitting feeds yarn across the fabric, with each new loop intermeshing with the previous loop along a course. Single jersey, rib and interlock are common constructions. Warp knitting feeds multiple warp yarns simultaneously, with each yarn forming loops in the lengthwise direction; tricot and raschel are representative groups. The different feeding systems affect construction, run resistance, dimensional stability and the ability to produce meshes or patterns.
translations.Trên hàng thực tế, nhận diện đường chạy: In production, identify the loop path and reverse side before assigning a commercial construction name. When changing suppliers, request the machine/construction description, yarn composition, width, GSM and an approved reference sample. The same commercial term, such as “mesh”, may refer to warp knit, weft knit or nonwoven material.
translations.Single jersey có mặt phải thường thấy cá: Single jersey typically shows V-shaped loop legs on the face and loop arcs on the reverse; its cut edges tend to curl. Rib alternates face and reverse wales and generally provides substantial crosswise stretch. Interlock is a double-knit construction with relatively balanced faces, and is often thicker and more stable than single jersey under comparable conditions. Thickness and stability must be confirmed on a sample of the actual fabric code and finishing condition.
translations.Khi chọn rib làm bo, kiểm tra tỷ lệ rib,: When selecting rib for a band or cuff, check the rib ratio, crosswise extension, recovery after repeated stretching and compatibility with the garment edge. During sample sewing, record the band length before and after attachment, the distribution of gathering and seam condition after washing. Do not assess it only immediately after sewing.
translations.05 · Tuck, miss, jacquard và biến thể: 05 · Tuck, Miss, Jacquard and Related Structures
translations.Tuck giữ vòng cũ trong khi tạo vòng mới: A tuck stitch retains an old loop while a new loop is formed at the needle position, changing thickness and surface appearance. A miss or float omits loop formation at a selected position, allowing the yarn to float across the fabric. Jacquard controls colour or structure by area. Fleece, terry, pile and spacer constructions use additional loop geometry or yarn systems to create thickness, surface texture or internal space.
translations.Với jacquard nhiều màu, kiểm tra mặt trá: For multicolour jacquard, inspect the reverse side, long floats, yarn-catching points and the risk of snagging on accessories. For terry and fleece, assess pile direction, fibre shedding and shade differences when garment pieces are laid in opposite directions. These factors directly affect marker planning and finished appearance.
translations.Máy circular tạo vải dạng ống hoặc mở kh: Circular knitting machines produce tubular or open-width fabric depending on their configuration. Flat knitting machines produce panels or shaped components, while warp knitting machines use needle systems and guide bars. Common elements include latch needles, sinkers, cams, feeders, cylinders/dials and needle beds. Worn needles, incorrect cam settings, unstable yarn feeding or fluctuating tension can cause needle lines, dropped stitches and barré.
translations.Khi điều tra lỗi, lập sơ đồ vị trí kim/f: When investigating defects, map needle and feeder positions around the machine circumference and compare them with the defect locations on the fabric tube. Record the machine ID, gauge, needle type, yarn lot, feeder, shift and needle-change time. This data helps distinguish defects recurring at a machine position from defects associated with a material lot.
translations.Sợi cho knitting cần độ đều, độ bền, độ: Knitting yarn requires suitable evenness, strength, cleanliness and friction for the machine speed. Excessive tension can shorten loops, tighten the fabric and increase yarn breaks; insufficient tension can cause unstable feeding and loose loops. Hairiness, twist, knots, package build and lubricants also affect yarn movement.
translations.Phiếu kiểm tra sợi nên có count, twist,: The yarn inspection record should include count, twist, strength, evenness, hairiness, moisture/conditioning, lot and supplier details as required by the purchase specification. When changing a package or lot, monitor yarn breaks by spindle/feeder and running time. Changing several parameters at once makes root-cause identification difficult.
translations.Sau khi rời máy, ứng suất trong vòng đượ: After the fabric leaves the machine, stresses within the loops are released and the fabric dimensions change. Dyeing, drying, compacting and heat setting can cause further changes. Spirality or skew is the twisting or displacement of courses or garment side seams. Causes may relate to construction, yarn twist direction, tension, machinery and finishing.
translations.Đo chiều dài và khổ trên cùng một mẫu đã: Measure length and width on the same marked specimen before treatment, after relaxation and after finishing. Report lengthwise/widthwise shrinkage separately from spirality/skew; a sample may have low shrinkage and still show course distortion. Use results confirmed on a representative lot and the actual finishing route when preparing patterns.
translations.Needle line thường tạo sọc dọc; barré tạ: Needle lines typically appear as lengthwise stripes. Barré appears as crosswise bands caused by differences in yarn, loop formation or dyeing. A dropped stitch can create a hole or ladder. Other defects include slubs, oil stains, contamination, holes, pilling, GSM variation and shade variation. Defect shape, direction and repetition are key evidence for isolating the cause.
translations.Phân loại lỗi theo dạng liên tục/ngắt qu: Classify defects as continuous or intermittent, periodic or random. Mark the face, course/wale direction and distance from the beginning of the roll. Photographs should include the defect code, a scale and the roll ID so the location can be identified accurately.
translations.Kiểm tra đầu vào thường gồm thành phần x: Incoming inspection commonly covers fibre composition, usable width, GSM, colour, shade continuity, shrinkage, spirality, stretch/recovery, pilling or abrasion where required, and visual defects. For stretch knits, patterns and markers must account for the stretch direction. The seam type and thread must not break or unduly restrict the fabric's extensibility.
translations.Phiếu release vải nên nối kết quả kiểm t: The fabric release record should link inspection results to the roll ID and cutting plan, including shade grouping, usable width, shrinkage, spirality, GSM and required tests. If a roll has an outlying result, keep it on separate status and assess the impact on marker planning, size ratio and component quantities before releasing it to production.
translations.Nonwoven là cấu trúc tấm xơ được liên kế: A nonwoven is a fibrous sheet structure bonded mechanically, thermally or with an adhesive. The process commonly includes web formation, bonding, finishing and conversion into a product.
translations.Các công đoạn có thể tích hợp liên tục t: Depending on the technology, these operations may be integrated into a continuous production line.
translations.Nonwoven không tạo bằng hệ sợi dọc-ngang: Unlike woven fabric, a nonwoven is not formed by interlacing warp and weft yarns; unlike knitted fabric, it is not formed from intermeshing loops. Staple fibres or filaments are distributed into a web and then bonded thermally, mechanically or chemically. The material may be coated or built up in multiple layers, so the term “nonwoven” alone does not fully describe its end-use performance.
translations.Trong hồ sơ mua hàng, ghi rõ web formati: Purchasing documents should specify web formation, bonding method, polymer/fibre, finish and layer construction. Stating only “40 GSM nonwoven” does not indicate whether the material uses a binder or thermal bonding, how the fibres are oriented or whether it has a coating.
translations.Drylaid/card-based mở và chải xơ thành w: Drylaid or card-based processes open and card fibres into a web. Airlaid disperses fibres in an air stream; wetlaid disperses fibres in water before draining the suspension on a screen. Spunlaid extrudes molten polymer into filaments and lays them on a moving belt. Meltblown uses high-velocity air to attenuate polymer streams into microfibres. Each web-forming method produces different fibre distributions and directional properties.
translations.Chất lượng web được xem qua basis-weight: Web quality is assessed through the cross-width basis-weight profile, surface uniformity, fibre orientation and continuity. When streaks occur, determine whether they run in the machine direction (MD) or cross direction (CD). MD defects often require checks of fixed line components, while CD variation calls for an assessment of cross-width distribution.
translations.Spunbond thường gồm cấp polymer, đùn nón: A typical spunbond line includes polymer feeding, melt extrusion, filtration, metering, a spinneret, quenching/drawing, web formation, bonding and winding. Polypropylene is common, but polyester and other polymers are also used. Strength and softness depend on the polymer, filament diameter, bonding pattern and basis weight.
translations.Trong spunbond, các điểm cần truy nguyên: For spunbond, trace the polymer lot, melt-flow value against the material specification, extrusion/drawing conditions, quenching, belt speed and bonding. When the polymer or line conditions change, compare MD/CD tensile strength, elongation, softness and the basis-weight profile together.
translations.Meltblown dùng khí nóng tốc độ cao để ké: Meltblown uses high-velocity hot air to attenuate polymer into microfibres, creating a web with a large surface area. It is often used as a functional layer in composites. SMS is a spunbond–meltblown–spunbond construction: the outer layers provide support and strength, while the middle layer may provide filtration or barrier performance as designed. SMS filtration and liquid-barrier performance must be established through the relevant functional tests on the specified construction and material lot.
translations.Với cấu trúc SMS hoặc composite tương tự: For SMS and similar composites, record the layer sequence, each layer's basis weight where disclosed by the supplier, bonding method and face orientation. When investigating delamination or performance changes, sample multiple roll locations and determine whether the fault lies at the interface, in the web or in the converting process.
translations.Thermal bonding dùng nhiệt/áp lực làm mề: Thermal bonding uses heat and pressure to soften the bonding component; methods include calender point bonding and through-air bonding. Mechanical bonding includes needle punching, hydroentanglement/spunlace and stitch bonding. Chemical bonding applies a binder by saturation, spraying, foaming or printing. Each method affects softness, porosity, tensile strength and absorbency differently.
translations.Needle-punched web cần xem mật độ/độ sâu: For needle-punched webs, assess needle density/penetration depth and fibre orientation. For hydroentangled webs, assess water-jet energy and uniformity. For thermal bonding, review the pattern and bonded areas. For chemical bonding, control binder add-on and distribution. These factors explain why materials with the same GSM can differ in softness and strength.
translations.Finishing có thể gồm cán, phủ, tẩm, xử l: Finishing may include calendering, coating, impregnation, surface treatment, printing, embossing or layer bonding. Coating applies a layer to a surface; lamination joins two or more layers using adhesive, heat or another method. These treatments change air permeability, water resistance, friction, stiffness and heat-sealing behaviour.
translations.Khi xác nhận laminate, kiểm tra độ bám g: When approving a laminate, inspect interlayer adhesion, adhesive uniformity, bonded edges, distortion and changes after folding or bending. Record the supplier's bonding conditions and adhesive code. If the substrate or finish changes, repeat the compatibility assessment rather than relying on previous results.
translations.GSM là khối lượng trên diện tích, thường: GSM is mass per unit area, usually expressed in g/m². Thickness is measured under a specified presser-foot pressure. Materials with the same GSM may have different thicknesses and porosities. MD is the machine direction and CD is the cross direction; fibre orientation can produce different tensile strength and elongation in the two directions.
translations.Với thickness, ghi rõ áp lực chân đo, di: For thickness measurements, state the presser-foot pressure, foot area and reading time required by the method because porous materials are easily compressed. For tensile testing, cut specimens in the correct MD/CD directions and record specimen width, gauge length, test speed and result treatment under the applicable standard.
translations.Nonwoven xuất hiện trong interlining/fus: Nonwovens are used in interlinings/fusible interfacings, linings, reinforcement, bags, dust covers, filters and protective apparel. An interlining may carry an adhesive coating for fusing to the shell fabric. Bond strength and dimensional stability depend on the adhesive, shell fabric, temperature, pressure, dwell time and differential shrinkage between layers.
translations.Interlining cần kiểm tra cả độ co rút củ: For interlinings, check the shrinkage of both the interlining and shell fabric after fusing; differential shrinkage can cause bubbling or puckering. For bags and dust covers, assess seam strength, tear strength and abrasion at load-bearing locations. GSM alone cannot predict service life.
translations.Lỗi thường gặp gồm basis weight không đề: Common defects include uneven basis weight, streaks/bands, pinholes, weak bonding, hard spots, contamination, delamination, edge curl, blocking and lint. Causes may involve fibre distribution, polymer flow, spinnerets, suction, belt speed, temperature, nip pressure or binder.
translations.Bản đồ lỗi cần ghi lỗi theo MD/CD, khoản: The defect map should record the MD/CD direction, distance from the left/right edge and distance from the beginning of the roll. For delamination, retain both an intact sample and a separated sample to assess the failure surface. For pinholes, record size, frequency and cross-width distribution.
translations.Chọn nonwoven theo chức năng. Interlinin: Select nonwovens according to their function. Interlinings require compatible shrinkage, drape, adhesive bonding and wash/press performance. Bags require tensile, tear, seam and abrasion performance. Filter/barrier materials require dedicated functional tests. Confirm composition, GSM, thickness, roll width, MD/CD properties, colour, finish, shelf life and storage conditions.
translations.Quy trình duyệt nên gồm mẫu chuẩn, bảng: The approval process should include a reference sample, specification sheet, test methods, a pilot lot and evaluation in the finished product. Any change to polymer, supplier, bonding, finish or usable width should be recorded in a change notice, with affected tests and the result approver identified.
translations.Phòng thực hành cấu trúc vải và kiểm tra: Workshop: Fabric Construction and Specification Checks
translations.Phần thực hành hướng dẫn nhận diện cấu t: This workshop covers construction identification, technology comparison and calculation of basic parameters. During material inspection, record the fabric code, face side, course/wale or MD/CD direction, sampling location and measurement method so that results remain traceable.
translations.Piqué có nhiều biến thể. Khi phân loại v: Piqué has several variations. When classifying the material, compare the fabric face, reverse and construction stated in the supplier's documentation.
translations.Thường có mặt phải/mặt trái khác nhau rõ: The face and reverse are usually clearly different; cut edges tend to curl. Commonly used for T-shirts and base layers.
translations.Cột vòng mặt phải và mặt trái xen kẽ; th: Face and reverse wales alternate. Commonly used for neckbands, cuffs, hems and garment panels requiring crosswise stretch.
translations.Double knit cân bằng hơn về hai mặt; thư: A double-knit construction has more balanced faces and is generally more stable and thicker than single jersey under comparable conditions.
translations.Nhóm cấu trúc tạo bề mặt nổi/texture; tê: This group creates a raised or textured surface. Commercial names may cover several variations, so the exact construction must be confirmed.

translations.CPI (courses per inch) là số hàng vòng t: CPI (courses per inch) is the number of courses in one inch; WPI (wales per inch) is the number of wales in one inch. Measure a specimen conditioned or relaxed according to the specified method. Align the ruler with the course or wale direction, count over a defined length and avoid including boundary loops incorrectly.
translations.Ví dụ: trên chiều dài 10 cm, đếm được 52: Example: over a length of 10 cm, 52 courses and 48 wales are counted. Convert 10 cm = 10 ÷ 2.54 = 3.937 inches.
translations.Đây là dữ liệu luyện tập. Báo cáo thật p: These are practice data. An actual report must state the fabric type, sampling location, relaxation/conditioning state, number of measurements, method used to identify courses/wales and test method.

Retain results by material code, lot and revision for comparison when the supplier or construction changes.

translations.Tài liệu học nghề chuyên sâu dành cho ng: A specialist learning resource for technical teams, QC, product development, material sourcing and garment production management. It explains constructions, processes, defects and practical inspection methods.
How to Study and Apply This Material
translations.Với mỗi cấu trúc, hãy nhận diện hướng sợ: For each construction, identify the yarn/loop direction, surface, bonding method and relevant inspection parameters. For each style, record the test standard, specimen-conditioning conditions, sampling location, unit and applicable specification revision so results can be compared.
translations.Khi đánh giá vải, phân biệt stretch do c: When evaluating fabric, distinguish structural stretch from elastane stretch. Test both extension and growth/recovery after stretching using the agreed test method.
translations.Báo cáo kiểm tra phải ghi trạng thái rel: Inspection reports must state relaxation status, units, measurement direction, loop count and method. Measurements taken immediately off the machine may differ from those taken after finishing.
translations.Khi đặt hàng, ghi rõ weft knit hay warp: Purchase orders must specify weft knit or warp knit and the exact construction. “Knit fabric” alone is insufficient for material control.
translations.Nếu cổ áo bị bai, kiểm tra cấu trúc rib,: If a neckline loses recovery, inspect the rib construction, elastane, loop density, loop length and sewing/pressing process. If a garment body twists, check fabric spirality before attributing the issue to the seam.
translations.Với bề mặt pile/fleece, xác định chiều n: For pile/fleece surfaces, identify nap direction and snagging risks before preparing the marker. Pieces cut in opposite directions may show different shades under light.
translations.Khi có sọc dọc lặp lại, đánh dấu vị trí: When a repeating lengthwise stripe appears, mark its position around the roll and compare it with needle/feeder positions. Record the machine, shift, yarn lot and detection time for traceability.
translations.Khi đứt sợi tăng, kiểm tra đường dẫn, mắ: When yarn breaks increase, inspect the yarn path, ceramic guides, package, knots, yarn quality and needle condition before changing tension or machine speed.
translations.Đánh dấu đường chuẩn trước và sau hoàn t: Mark reference lines before and after finishing. Measure lengthwise/widthwise shrinkage and assess spirality using the correct method. For garments with twisted side seams, also check pattern placement and course/wale direction.
translations.Lập bản đồ lỗi theo chiều dài cuộn và ch: Map defects by roll length and fabric width, take photographs with a scale, and retain the roll ID, yarn lot, machine, feeder and dye lot. Do not record only “fabric defect”.
translations.Trước bulk cutting, xác nhận relax time,: Before bulk cutting, confirm relaxation time, spreading direction, shrinkage allowance and wash-test results where required. Pass/fail criteria must be stated in the order specification.
translations.Spec cần ghi polymer/fiber composition,: The specification should state polymer/fibre composition, GSM, thickness, MD/CD tensile strength, elongation, bonding type and finish. Two materials with the same GSM may differ in softness, strength and breathability.
translations.Khi so tensile, xem cả MD (machine direc: When comparing tensile results, review both MD (machine direction) and CD (cross direction). A web with oriented fibres may have substantially different strength in the two directions.
translations.Nếu vật liệu giòn tại nếp gấp, kiểm tra: If the material becomes brittle at folds, check the polymer, bonding level, heat/UV ageing and storage conditions. Verify the issue through tensile, elongation and tear tests rather than touch alone.
translations.Với vật liệu barrier, yêu cầu đúng phép: For barrier materials, request the tests relevant to the application, such as filtration efficiency, pressure drop, hydrostatic resistance or penetration resistance.
translations.Vật liệu quá cứng có thể do binder add-o: Excessive stiffness may result from binder add-on, calender temperature/pressure or a high bonded-area ratio. Increasing bonding to improve strength may reduce softness and permeability.
translations.Nếu laminate bong, kiểm tra độ sạch, năn: If a laminate delaminates, check cleanliness, surface energy, adhesive type, temperature/pressure/time and polymer compatibility. Sample multiple locations to distinguish a local defect from a lot-wide issue.
translations.Phiếu thử cần ghi phương pháp, kích thướ: Test records must state the method, specimen dimensions, sample count, conditioning conditions, MD/CD direction and thickness-measurement pressure. Do not compare results obtained under different test conditions.
translations.Trước bulk fusing, thử trên đúng vải chí: Before bulk fusing, test on the actual shell fabric using the production fusing machine. Check peel/bond strength, bubbling, strike-through, colour change, surface gloss and post-wash shrinkage where required.
translations.Nếu streak kéo dài theo MD, kiểm tra vị: If a streak runs in the MD, inspect fixed positions at the web-forming head or distribution system. For cross-width variation, check the temperature profile, fibre/polymer distribution and nip pressure.
translations.Duyệt mẫu chuẩn, tiêu chí kiểm tra và kế: Approve the reference sample, inspection criteria and sampling plan. Any supplier or construction change must be reassessed in the actual product.
translations.knit hình thành từ vòng sợi liên kết; no: Knitted fabric is formed from interconnected yarn loops; nonwoven is formed from a bonded fibre/filament web. For knits, record CPI/WPI. For nonwovens, record GSM, thickness, MD/CD tensile strength, elongation and application-specific functional tests.
translations.Số vòng trên inch = số vòng đếm được ÷ c: Loops per inch = number of loops counted ÷ measured length (inches)
translations.dùng cutter/mẫu có diện tích đã biết và: Use a cutter/specimen with a known area and a balance with adequate resolution. Select the sample count and locations according to the test method. Do not compare a damp specimen with a conditioned one. For striped/patterned fabrics or materials with cross-width variation, take representative samples under the inspection plan.

description_vi: Chuyên đề công nghệ dệt kim và vải không dệt: cấu trúc vòng sợi, weft/warp knitting, nonwoven web formation, bonding, kiểm tra GSM, CPI/WPI và lựa chọn vật liệu.
description_en: A technical guide to knitted and nonwoven fabrics, covering loop structure, weft and warp knitting, web formation, bonding, GSM, CPI/WPI and material selection.
